title: El messies de Dune
description: Paul Atreides gobierna un imperio transformado por la guerra y el culto a su figura. Mientras diversas facciones conspiran contra él, sus visiones del futuro revelan los límites del poder y el coste de haberse convertido en un símbolo religioso.

en.description: Paul Atreides rules an empire transformed by war and devotion to his image. As rival factions conspire against him, his visions of the future expose the limits of power and the cost of becoming a religious symbol.
